description:
* Manage NPI processes, including prototype/FAI products and pre-production builds in electrical box build, welding, and thermocouple fields.
* Develop and optimize manufacturing processes, work instructions, process flows, tooling, fixtures, test forms, and production layouts for NPI.
* Review product designs and provide DFM/DFA (Design for Manufacturing/Assembly) feedback to functional departments or THX stakeholders.
* Prepare and provide NPI status updates to project stakeholders and coordinate NPI activities from prototype through pilot builds and mass production.
* Support the creation of fixtures/test equipment to ensure products meet customer drawings.
* Report to the Assembly Manager.
requirements_text:
* Bachelor of Engineering.
* 1–3 years of experience as an engineer in Industrial, Mechatronics, or Mechanical Engineering.
* Good communication skills in English.
* Have experience in NPI processes, including prototype/FAI products and pre-production builds, especially in electrical box build, welding, thermocouples, etc.
* Good problem analysis and problem-solving skills.
* Proficient in Mechanical AutoCAD/Inventor/MS Office.

Công nghệ kỹ thuật, Cơ khí / Tự động hóa
